name: Okinawa Robin
rangeDescription: Okinawa (central ryukyu islands, southern japan)
description: Endemic resident of shady subtropical broadleaf forest understorey on the main island of Okinawa. Forages on the ground and often seen at the forest edge.

name: Xingu Scythebill
rangeDescription: Eastern amazonian brazil between the rio xingu and rio tocantins
description: A brown, tree-climbing bird with a strongly curved bill. Appears small-headed; plumage is mostly rufous-brown with buffy streaking on head and neck.

name: White-cheeked Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Montane forest of vietnam and southern laos
description: A garrulous, sociable bird, often found in large flocks, both single-species and mixed. Warm brown with a gray crown, a broad black mask, and a luminously white cheek spot, and long white-tipped tail.

name: Violet-eared Waxbill
rangeDescription: Angola to namibia, zambia, southern zimbabwe, botswana, and northern south africa
description: A stunning long-tailed waxbill with a red bill, mauve cheeks, and a blue rump. The underparts are vibrant chestnut in the male and cream-buff in the female.

name: Sumatran Whistling-Thrush
rangeDescription: Foothill forest of sumatra
description: Uncommon and unobtrusive, this chunky and mostly chestnut-colored bird is unlike any other whistling-thrush. Male has a dark blue head with an iridescent forehead, while the female has a brownish head.

name: White-bellied Go-away-bird
rangeDescription: Acacia savanna of somalia and ethiopia to northeastern tanzania
description: An unusual gray turaco with a long tail and a towering crest. White marks on the sides of the tail are conspicuous in floppy flight.

name: Rote Myzomela
rangeDescription: Rote (lesser sundas)
description: A small honeyeater with a downcurved bill. Males blackish with a vivid red hood and rump and a paler belly.

name: Garden Emerald
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica and panama; coiba and pearl islands
description: Small hummingbird with limited range. Male entirely glittering green with dark forked tail.

name: Brown-rumped Foliage-gleaner
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to southeastern peru, far northwestern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Subtly-patterned foliage-gleaner. Warm dark brown overall, lighter below, with an orange-brown throat patch, and red eye.

name: Gray-breasted Partridge
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern java
description: Unique partridge of Java’s eastern highlands, where it inhabits primary forest from 500 to 2200 meters. Dark gray overall with a distinctive bright white face, which sets it apart from all other gamebirds in its limited range.

name: Ituri Batis
rangeDescription: Humid forest of democratic republic of the congo and adjacent western uganda
description: A very small and striking gray, white, and black flycatcher-like bird with a very dark crown, a yellow eye, white wingbars, and a white spot above the bill base. Sexes similar.

name: Golden-shouldered Parrot
rangeDescription: Northeastern australia (interior southern cape york peninsula)
description: Slender, long-tailed parrot restricted to a tiny range in tropical savanna woodland in far northern Queensland. Male a striking turquoise color, with red lower belly, tiny black cap, and yellow forecrown.

name: Mottled Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Makira island (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A tiny round bird with a slightly downturned bill. Brown on the back, wings, and crown.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Camiguin Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Camiguin (philippines)
description: A very small parrot of upland forest on Camiguin island. Overall green in color with a bluish face, an orange bill and legs, and a red crown and rump.

name: North Island Kokako
rangeDescription: North and great barrier islands (new zealand)
description: Large songbird confined to a few scattered forests in the northern half of the North Island of New Zealand, and some offshore island sanctuaries where predator control is undertaken. Adults have a slate blue-gray body with vibrant cerulean wattles and a distinct black mask.

name: Velvety Black-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (northeastern bahia and alagoas to northeastern rio grande do sul)
description: Large flycatcher found in montane grassy and rocky open areas. Uniformly glossy blue-black with a short crest.

name: Tepui Swift
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela, adjacent northwestern guyana, and northern brazil (roraima)
description: Large, dark swift of tepui highlands. Note generally dark appearance, broad wings, and forked tail.

name: Highland Elaenia
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern ecuador to bolivia and northwestern argentina
description: Medium-sized flycatcher with a small head and long tail. Found in forests and second growth.

name: Rufous-bellied Bush-Tyrant
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southern peru (pasco) to western bolivia
description: Subtly patterned reddish-brown flycatcher of high-elevation montane forests. Perches upright, often on the tops of snags or bushes around forest edges and clearings.

name: Peruvian Pygmy-Owl
rangeDescription: Lowlands and foothills of southwestern ecuador and western peru
description: Very small owl of desert and western foothills of the Andes; no other pygmy-owl in its range. Overall plumage tones vary from brown to gray-brown, rarely rusty brown.
